_note: Forms (what a player can be). IDs are stable (lower snake_case). loadout: weapons.json IDs (for monsters their body attacks); skills: skills.json IDs (a form with the skill projectile casts the bolt with its off-hand button). model: whose model the form is shown with (Content/Characters/<model>; empty = its own id). evolutions: forms it can evolve into. requires_imprint: element whose imprint the evolution into this form needs (elements.json; empty = none). element_body: element of its body - melee hits against it deal that damage back (empty = none). Numbers live in values.json.
